products.name: GoAnyAPI
products.tagline: One API key for SEO, AI search, and Google Ads data
products.description:
GoAnyAPI gives developers, SEO teams, and AI agents structured web data through a single API key. Use it to build competitor dashboards, keyword research tools, and automated reports.

  • Website intelligence: Look up traffic and its sources, domain age, domain ratings, and backlinks.

  • Search and keywords: Get Google and Bing search results, autocomplete suggestions, keyword difficulty scores, and Google Trends data.

  • AI search and ads: Collect Google AI Overview summaries and AI Mode answers with citations, and look up ads in the Google Ads Transparency Center.

Integrate via REST API, CLI, or MCP. Use the online API Tester and documentation to review parameters and sample responses. Prepaid credits share one balance across APIs, with usage billed at each endpoint's listed rate.

products.name: Screentell
products.tagline: The in-browser screen recorder for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Record screen, camera, and audio with auto focus zoom, 3D motion, and annotations. No desktop app required.
products.description:
Screentell is a browser-based screen recorder for Mac, Windows, and Linux that captures screen, camera, and audio without a desktop app. Recording, editing, and exporting are handled in the browser, and processing is local. Users can record a window or full screen with simultaneous screen, camera, system sound, and microphone capture.

Main uses include creating demos, tutorials, and social videos. Distinctive features are auto focus zoom and pan, cinematic 3D transforms, customizable annotation stickers, a movable face cam layer, clip cutting and speed control, screen cropping, and background layout options for HD export.

products.name: Lovimg
products.tagline: Curated image prompts for AI creators
products.description:
Lovimg is a free library of over 10,000 copy-ready AI image prompts for models including ChatGPT, GPT Image 2, Nano Banana and Seedance 2.0. Prompts can be pasted directly into a model to generate images, with no prompt engineering experience required. The library covers categories such as photography and cinematic imagery, people and characters, anime and manga, 3D render, posters and layout, branding and logos, product and e-commerce, architecture, and illustration and art.

  • Prompts are organised by category and by model

  • Featured, latest and popular browsing options

  • An AI image generation tool is also available on the site

products.name: ChemAI Atlas
products.tagline: Discover, Learn & Apply AI in Chemistry
products.description:
ChemAI Atlas is a directory for exploring AI and computational chemistry tools, covering models, agents, MCP servers, skills, APIs, datasets, open-source libraries and platforms. It is aimed at researchers and developers who want to understand how these resources fit into chemistry research workflows.

The site organizes resources by category and offers practical Recipes that start from a research task, such as molecular docking with pose validation, crystal relaxation with SevenNet and ASE, or GNN baselines for QM9 dipoles. It also documents CARS, a Chemistry AI Recipe Specification.

products.name: SpritePixel
products.tagline: A project-based AI game asset studio for indie developers creating consistent sprites, animations and matching asset sets.
products.description:
SpritePixel is an AI sprite generator for indie game developers producing 2D game assets. Starting from text prompts, it generates original characters, then creates outfit variations that keep the same base character for skins, classes, and NPC variants.

It builds multi-direction sprites (front, side, back) for RPG and top-down workflows, and animates characters across actions such as idle, walk, run, jump, dash, attack, shoot, cast, and hurt. Animation frames are exported as organized sprite sheets for game development.

  • Multi-direction directional sprites with consistent character identity

  • Action animation generation

  • Sprite sheet export, plus free Sprite Sheet Maker and Cutter tools

products.name: MeetNote
products.tagline: AI meeting notes that turn talks into tasks.
products.description: MeetNote auto-records and transcribes Zoom and Google Meet calls, or imports audio/video files. Get instant AI notes, summaries, decisions and tasks in one workspace — synced with ClickUp, Slack and Notion. Free on Google Play.

products.name: SpeechCue
products.tagline: A teleprompter that follows your voice, even offline.
products.description:
SpeechCue is a teleprompter for creators, teachers, and presenters. Its voice-following mode uses on-device speech recognition to follow your script as you speak, so you can focus on your delivery.

Read in full screen, adjust the scrolling, keep your screen awake, and mirror the text for teleprompter hardware. Organize scripts locally and optionally sync them across devices with an account. On Android, Pro includes a floating prompt window. The macOS app also supports a separate output window and external displays.

SpeechCue is available for iOS, Android, and macOS. Offline voice recognition supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Cantonese. Features and availability can vary by platform and plan.

products.name: Ruumix
products.tagline: AI room design with conversational edits and furniture shopping links
products.description: Ruumix helps homeowners and interior designers explore furnishing ideas from a room photo. Describe a style or change, refine concepts through conversation, and compare options side by side on an infinite canvas. Explore furniture shopping links while planning a room. Free and paid plans are available; current plans and limits are published at https://www.ruumix.ai/pricing.

products.name: YTAPI
products.tagline: Transcripts for YouTube videos, fast the first time.
products.description:
YTAPI is a YouTube transcript API that returns captions for videos, including uncached ones, with a stated median response time of 644 ms and 99.99% success over 500k+ requests. It is intended for developers and applications that need to retrieve YouTube transcripts programmatically.

Output formats include segments, Markdown, SRT and VTT, with optional word-level timestamps. Billing applies only to HTTP 200 responses.

products.name: AI Legal Research
products.tagline: The leading platform for discovering AI legal research tools, prompts, and workflows.
products.description:
AI Legal Research is an AI-powered assistant that helps people understand legal situations and decide what to do next. Users can ask a legal question, paste a contract clause, NDA, lease, or other document, and receive plain-language explanations, drafted demand letters, and guidance on rights in tenant, employment, and consumer matters. It is intended for individuals preparing to speak with a lawyer, and provides legal information rather than legal advice.

The site offers free tools including a Legal Research Roadmap, Case Brief Generator, Legal Citation Extractor, Legal Text Summarizer, Contract Clause Analyzer, NDA Risk Triage (a green/yellow/red assessment), and a Demand Letter Drafter. It also publishes independent reviews of AI legal research tools, including Harvey AI and CoCounsel. Three free uses a day are available with no signup required.

products.name: FreetempMail
products.tagline: A free email in one click. No signup, no tracking.
products.description:
FreetempMail is a browser-based disposable email service that creates a private temporary email address in one click, with no signup required. It is intended for anyone who needs an inbox for signups, free trials, one-off newsletters, or other situations where sharing a real address isn't desirable.

Distinctive features include rendering real HTML email so links, images, and buttons work, and a stated policy of no ads, no captchas, and no third-party scripts. The site also offers browser-based privacy tools: a QR code generator, UUID generator, password generator, and email privacy checker. Common uses cited are verifying Discord accounts, reading a single newsletter, burning an address after a free trial, and testing signup flows.

products.name: GridBulk
products.tagline: Create and split up to 16 AI images from one prompt
products.description: GridBulk generates a grid of images from a prompt and splits it into individual assets. Create up to 16 images in one run for projects such as social posts, product visuals, and creative exploration.

products.name: SheetDo
products.tagline: Free online Excel training with interactive practice and instant formula grading.
products.description:
SheetDo is a free, in-browser Excel training platform where you solve real spreadsheet challenges by typing actual formulas into a formula bar and receiving instant Pass/Fail grading from a live spreadsheet engine. No installation is required.

Learners can browse problems by topic and difficulty, from basic arithmetic and averaging to nested IF grading and XLOOKUP. The site also offers formula guides with syntax breakdowns and common mistakes, micro-tools such as freeze-panes and duplicate-highlighter simulators plus CAGR calculators, and searchable Windows/Mac shortcut cheatsheets.

products.name: SaveXZ
products.tagline: Download Twitter/X videos, GIFs & images free
products.description: SaveXZ is a free online tool to download videos, GIFs and images from Twitter/X. Paste a tweet link and save media in original quality, with no watermark, no sign-up and no app to install. Works on desktop and mobile.

products.name: PayForGPT
products.tagline: Independent ChatGPT Plus/Pro top-up store for users in China
products.description: PayForGPT is an independent online store that helps users in China get ChatGPT Plus and Pro without a foreign credit card. It sells three monthly plans: ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT 5x and ChatGPT 20x. Payment is by Alipay. Orders can be placed without registering. After payment, a dedicated one-on-one WeChat service helps activate the plan on the buyer's own ChatGPT account. Every order can be tracked on the order page. PayForGPT is a third-party store, not affiliated with OpenAI.

products.name: MyAIVideo
products.tagline: Free online AI video maker for short clips and full videos. No editing skills needed.
products.description:
MyAIVideo is a free online AI video maker for creating short clips and full videos from text or images without editing skills. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video generation, producing MP4 clips up to 1080P with selectable resolution and aspect ratio.

It is intended for social media creators and marketers making content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and rapid ad teasers. A Full Video workflow drafts a script, selects visuals, adds voiceover, captions, and background music, then assembles a publish-ready MP4 for explainers, marketing pages, and YouTube uploads. Generated results are saved in History for viewing and download.

products.name: Orbi
products.tagline: Ship reviewed code from GitHub issues.
products.description:
Orbi Cloud is a GitHub App that works through your issue backlog. Add the ai-ready label to an issue and Orbi's coding agent writes the change in an isolated workspace. Orbi opens a pull request. A separate review session checks the code and reruns tests after fixing what it finds. Orbi merges after CI passes. To publish a GitHub release, open a separate issue with the ai-ready and ai-release labels.

You can also run the open-source engine on your own machine. The first three merged pull requests on Orbi Cloud are free, with no credit card required.

GitHub repository: https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi

products.name: ReddTrends
products.tagline: Find buyers on Reddit. Reply without getting banned.
products.description:
ReddTrends helps businesses find the Reddit threads their buyers read, including threads Google and AI assistants surface for product searches. It is aimed at brands and founders who want to reach buyers on Reddit without having comments removed.

Each thread comes with a verdict, the subreddit's rules, and a suggested reply angle. ReddTrends also checks daily that a posted comment is still up and tracks where the thread ranks weekly. Free, no account needed.

products.name: X书签归档
products.tagline: 把 X 上收藏的书签和点赞同步到本地，离线搜索、AI 分类、随时导出。数据只存在你的浏览器里。
products.description:
X书签归档是一款 Chrome 扩展，用于将 X 上收藏的书签和点赞增量同步到浏览器本地，数据仅存储在 IndexedDB 中，不上传服务器。提供列表、紧凑、网格、图片墙四种视图，支持正文、作者、链接与文章内容的离线搜索及高亮，并可按标签、媒体、发布时间筛选和排序。

主要面向收藏量较大、需要按主题整理或导出到笔记软件的用户。专业版可用自有 DeepSeek 或 Claude Key 自动打标签，支持多账号分开归档，并可一键导出为 Obsidian 笔记、Markdown 或 CSV。同步仅调用书签和点赞两个只读接口，不执行点赞、收藏或发帖操作。

products.name: AIDesignHouse
products.tagline: AI House Design for Room Makeovers and Floor Plans
products.description:
AIDesignHouse is an online tool for AI-assisted house design. Users can upload a room photo to generate new interior concepts, create a floor plan concept from a written brief, or draw editable 2D/3D floor plans. The tools run in the browser, so there is no software to install and no CAD or 3D modeling skills are required.

Main uses include redesigning rooms with different furniture, finishes, and interior styles; adjusting floor plan settings such as area, room counts, building type, and drawing style; and comparing visual concepts before committing to a design.

products.name: Search1API
products.tagline: One API to search, crawl, and ingest the real-time web.
products.description:
Search1API provides a single API for searching, crawling, and ingesting the real-time web, giving AI agents access to current information beyond their training cutoff. It combines search engines, news, maps, crawling, screenshots, sitemaps, extraction, and deep crawling workflows behind one endpoint.

It is built for developers and teams creating AI agents and applications, with integration via REST API, MCP server, CLI, or agent skills. Search covers Google, Bing, YouTube, GitHub and more, and the API is compatible with Tavily, Exa, and SearXNG through a base URL change.

products.name: CocoCut
products.tagline: Everyday moments become mini vlogs.
products.description:
CocoCut is a mobile app that turns short clips of everyday moments into mini vlogs directly on your phone. Clips are lined up automatically by the time they were shot and stitched into one video, with no timeline editing or dragging required.

  • Exports real MP4 videos up to 4K, saved to Photos

  • Smart albums sort footage by trip and month, with one-tap selection of around 30 seconds

  • Keeps multiple vlogs separate, such as daily life, OOTD, meals, pets, or travel

Available on the App Store and Google Play.

products.name: FaceScore
products.tagline: Free AI attractiveness test and face analysis. Measured in your browser; your photo stays on your device.
products.description:
FaceScore is a free AI attractiveness test that estimates a score out of 10 from a front-facing selfie, along with facial symmetry, canthal tilt and face shape, in about ten seconds. The free scan runs entirely in the browser, so the photo is not uploaded, and no sign-up is required. It is aimed at people curious about how their facial proportions are measured.

The free scan maps 478 face points and reports symmetry from 23 mirrored point pairs, canthal tilt and face shape. A one-time $19 report adds explanations of seven proportions, strengths and improvement suggestions, four style previews, a makeup try-on and a 30-day retest. Scores are estimates from facial proportions, not an objective measure of beauty.

products.name: AIDirs
products.tagline: Discover the BestAI Tools Directory
products.description:
AIDirs is a curated directory for discovering AI tools, organized by practical categories such as AI Video, AI Image, AI Music, and AI Art. It lists newly added products with descriptions and tags, and offers fast search plus filtering and sorting by category, tag, and date to help users find tools for their workflow.

  • Tool listings include short descriptions and relevant category and use-case tags.

  • Features search, category and tag filters, and sorting, including by newest first.

  • Includes a CLI and agent skills to speed up tool submission.

products.name: Quiet Hours
products.tagline: Your private journal safespace
products.description: Quiet Hours is a private daily reflection journal for iPhone and Android. A calm daily prompt helps you reflect, and you can add photo and video moments, voice memos, and mood tracking with weekly story recaps. There's a daily tarot pull from a 78-card deck, a map of your memories, and a Quote of the Day widget, with thoughtful gratitude prompts woven through. It works fully offline, collects no data, and has no feed, no followers, and no ads. Free to download, with an optional Premium upgrade.

products.name: Scrapewise
products.tagline: Turn ALL your competitors' pages into clean data.
products.description: Scrapewise is a pay-as-you-go web data platform with three parts: 35 ready data APIs for Amazon, Walmart, Google, YouTube and ChatGPT, AI scrapers that turn other public websites into structured rows, and an MCP server so AI agents can run both. There is no software to install — you work in the browser, or call the REST API. You top up a prepaid balance in euros, from EUR 5 to EUR 1,000, and pay per page delivered. The cheapest pages are EUR 0.15 per 1,000 delivered. Every new account gets 5 free requests, and no card is needed to sign up.

products.name: Unrust
products.tagline: Unassisted coding diagnostics and practice for developers
products.description: Unrust is a coding diagnostic and practice tool for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. The diagnostic runs without AI assistance or autocomplete and tests skills such as recall, debugging, tracing, code idioms, and finding flaws. Its results help developers identify areas to strengthen and review AI-generated code critically. The diagnostic and basic account features are free, with optional paid practice.

products.name: NoStairsPlease
products.tagline: Every small stage in the US, and who books it.
products.description:
NoStairsPlease is a venue directory covering 38,223 small and mid-size music venues across 10,286 US towns, built for musicians who book their own shows. Each venue listing includes booking contacts separated from general and rental contacts, room capacity, requirements, act format, photos and show history.

The map view colors rooms by show days in 90 days, and a route tool follows the road between chosen stops to list venues within 10 to 200 miles of the drive. Venue pages show weekday music patterns and past and upcoming shows, and artist pages list every venue where an act has played or is booked.

products.name: Put Me In
products.tagline: Put yourself in the meme: photo to video AI
products.description: Put Me In is a photo to video AI for memes. Pick a trending template, upload a photo of yourself, a friend or your pet, and get a short video of you in the meme, up to 15 seconds, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. From $4.99 a video, no subscription.

products.name: EmailWish
products.tagline: AI-powered, done-for-you (DFY) email marketing for Shopify stores: a cheaper, more powerful Klaviyo and Omnisend alternative.
products.description:
Emailwish is an AI-powered, done-for-you (DFY) email marketing platform for Shopify and WooCommerce, built on a customer data platform (CDP).

What's a cheaper alternative to Klaviyo? Emailwish is a cheaper, more powerful alternative to Klaviyo: it offers all of Klaviyo's targeting options plus chat, review, popup and wishlist targeting. It's an AI-powered, done-for-you (DFY) platform for Shopify with the highest deliverability, a free plan, and paid plans from $35/month.

What's a cheaper alternative to Omnisend? Emailwish is a cheaper, more powerful alternative to Omnisend: it sets up around 10 very detailed flows for you at onboarding, and you don't even have to upload your logo, social links or other brand assets, because everything is fetched automatically from your store. There's nothing to set up and no emails to write. It also has the highest deliverability, a free plan, and paid plans from $35/month.

products.name: Motionflare
products.tagline: Paste a URL → get a product promo video
products.description: Motionflare is an AI video tool for founders and marketers. Paste a product page URL and it generates a polished promo video you can post on social, landing pages, or ads. Skip the timeline grind—go from site to video in minutes.
